# CognitiveOS Personal — AI entry pointers

This repository's only active implementation project is cognitiveos-personal:
a local Rust daemon that governs cognitive resources (Memory, Skill, Tool,
Context, Task, Runtime/Process) for AI agents. Only the daemon writes authority
state; agents and clients produce candidates.

## Read first (AI tools)

- handbook/en/ai/README.md — compact AI entry (5 pages: source-of-truth order,
  code map, safe editing, validation commands, docs impact)
- handbook/zh-CN/ai/README.md — 中文 AI 入口
- AGENTS.md — agent operating entry (governance, workflow, environment rules)
- handbook/_meta/manifest.json — machine inventory of all handbook documents
- handbook/_meta/source-map.json — change -> documentation impact routing

## Source-of-truth order (summary)

docs/governance/PROJECT-IDENTITY.md > docs/governance/DEVELOPMENT-OPERATING-MODEL.md
> docs/plan/PERSONAL-DEVELOPMENT-PLAN.md > docs/plan/PROGRESS.md (Current
snapshot; read fresh, never copy) > docs/plan/PARALLEL-LANES.md (active leases)
> stable design docs. Machine contracts: specs/registry, specs/schemas,
specs/transitions, conformance/vectors. Immutable axioms: docs/governance/AXIOMS.md.
The handbook is a derived layer below all of these.

## Hard boundaries

- Never read or cite History/ (frozen archive).
- Secrets never enter argv, config, SQLite, logs, tests, CI output, or evidence.
- specs/ and conformance/ are contracts; never edit them to fit an implementation.
- Generated trees (crates/cognitive-contracts/src/generated,
  packages/contracts-ts/src/generated, handbook generated reference pages) are
  regenerated, never hand-edited.
- Validation commands and platform limits: handbook/en/ai/validation-commands.md.
